carpet.rule.exampleFeature.name: Example Feature
carpet.rule.safeSave.name: Safe Save
carpet.rule.safeSave.desc: Persist scheduled ticks and block events losslessly across a restart. Absolute triggerTick, global subTickOrder, Level.subTickCount and the ordered block-event queue are stored in <world>/safesave.dat. The server freezes before its first tick so the restored state can be inspected; run '/tick unfreeze' to resume.
carpet.rule.safeSaveRegions.name: SafeSave Protected Regions
carpet.rule.safeSaveRegions.desc: Record fully loaded ProtectedRegions when saving; region mode globally freezes startup until those regions are fully loaded again.
carpet.rule.safeSaveUnfreeze.name: SafeSave Unfreeze Mode
carpet.rule.safeSaveUnfreeze.desc: Startup freeze strategy: no_freeze, manual (/tick unfreeze), or region (automatically unfreeze after saved ProtectedRegions load).
carpet.rule.safeSaveRegionTimeout.name: Protected Region Startup Timeout
carpet.rule.safeSaveRegionTimeout.desc: Maximum server ticks to wait for saved ProtectedRegions in region mode; 0 releases immediately.
safesave.message.startup_frozen: [SafeSave] Waiting for the regions that were fully loaded at the last save. Game ticks are temporarily frozen and will automatically resume in at most %s server ticks (about %s seconds).
safesave.message.startup_unfrozen.comple: [SafeSave] All required regions are fully loaded; game ticks have resumed automatically.
safesave.message.startup_unfrozen.timeou: [SafeSave] The region loading wait timed out; game ticks have resumed automatically (%s/%s regions loaded).
safesave.message.startup_unfrozen.manual: [SafeSave] The startup region wait was cancelled manually; game ticks have resumed.
